decisions.reason: The flagship management platform builds directly on the firm's owned infrastructure, integrated tools and in-house R&D, so it lies within its absorptive capacity and agency-focused strategy.
The configurable managed hosting plan is a close extension of the core containerized hosting offer, so the firm can readily read its market results and refine it.

Extended PHP security support draws on the firm's documented technical know-how and its security and compliance focus, though as a newly launched, lightly promoted service it carries some risk of being folded into other offerings.
